newsitem.title: USA: PepsiCo says directors meeting today.
newsitem.headline: PepsiCo says directors meeting today.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc's board of directors is scheduled to meet Thurday, a company spokesman said.
He declined to say where the meeting will be held, or if the agenda included a vote on the spin-off of the company's vast chain-restaurant businesses.
The Wall Street Journal, citing unnamed sources, reported the company could announce the transaction as early as today.
The report touched off heavy buying in PepsiCo shares, which were up 2-1/2 to 34-3/8 in midmorning New York Stock Exchange trade, easing off a high of 35-7/8 reached earlier in the session.
PepsiCo was the NYSE's most active issue, with more than 11 million shares traded by 1045 EST/1545 GMT.
